description:
Detects path traversal attempts using ../ sequences or encoded variants to access files outside intended directories

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_011", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%directory%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%traversal%') AND "value" > 0
